title: Kissed Fatty Ukrainian Pork Dumplings
description: Fatty and chewy Ukrainian dumplings featuring shiso leaf and lamination puff pastry, served on a tagliere, perfect for a midnight craving
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine ground pork, chopped shiso leaves, chopped onion, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper, mixing well with your hands until just combined.
Roll out the lamination puff pastry on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of pastry using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of the pork mixture in the center of each pastry circle.
Brush the edges of the pastry with the beaten egg and fold the pastry over the filling, pressing the edges together to seal.
Use a fork to crimp the edges of the dumplings.
Place the dumplings on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving about 1 inch of space between each dumpling.
Brush the tops of the dumplings with the beaten egg and bake for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve the dumplings hot on a tagliere, garnished with additional shiso leaves if desired.
